draft.text:
Thanks for contacting Halden Support. Clarity monitors and Aero laptops are replaced under warranty when pixel defects exceed the policy thresholds.

1. Run the built-in self-test (monitor: hold the menu button 5 seconds; laptop: F12 LCD test) to confirm the pixel is not on the source.
2. Policy: replacement for any bright (always-on) pixel, or for 3 or more dark pixels, during the warranty period.
3. If your device meets the policy, reply with the service tag and a photo, and an agent will arrange the exchange.

If this doesn't solve it, reply to this message and a technician will pick it up. (Ref: KB-HW-05)

Thanks for contacting Halden Support. Drivers are published per model on the Halden Support Drivers page and through the Halden Update app.

1. Open Halden Update (preinstalled) and choose Check for updates; install everything marked Recommended.
2. Without the app: go to the Drivers page, enter the service tag or choose the model, filter by your OS.
3. Install chipset first, then graphics, audio, network, touchpad and camera, restarting when asked.
4. Unknown devices in Device Manager: right-click, Properties, Details, Hardware Ids; search that ID on the Drivers page.

If this doesn't solve it, reply to this message and a technician will pick it up. (Ref: KB-SW-01)

retrieval.title: Reset or reinstall the operating system
Find and install drivers for Halden laptops and desktops

draft.text:
Thanks for contacting Halden Support. Halden Recovery restores the factory image from the recovery partition or from a USB stick.

1. Back up files first; a reset can remove personal data.
2. From Windows: Settings, System, Recovery, Reset this PC.
3. If Windows will not start: press F11 at power-on to open Halden Recovery and choose Restore factory image.
4. No recovery partition: create a USB stick with the Halden Recovery Media tool on another computer (16 GB or larger) and boot from it with F12.
5. For boot loops or INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE, run the built-in disk check from the F12 diagnostics menu before reinstalling.

If this doesn't solve it, reply to this message and a technician will pick it up. (Ref: KB-SW-03)
